selected_evidence.requirement: Identify which node1 interface connects to which host
selected_evidence.summary: Temporary IP assignment and directional ping test proved eth1 reaches node2 (172.31.99.2) and eth2 reaches node3 (172.31.98.3)

selected_evidence.requirement: eth1/eth2 configured as untagged access ports in separate VLANs on node1
selected_evidence.summary: bridge vlan show confirms eth1 PVID/Egress Untagged VLAN10, eth2 PVID/Egress Untagged VLAN20, VLAN1 removed

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 (VLAN10) has a working link to node1
node3 (VLAN20) has a working link to node1
node2 and node3 are isolated from each other despite VLAN separation
selected_evidence.summary: node3 given overlapping IP 192.168.10.3/24 on enp8s0; node2 (192.168.10.2) ping to it fails 100% (Destination Host Unreachable), proving VLAN-level L2 isolation rather than mere subnet mismatch

selected_evidence.requirement: Configuration persists across reboot (systemd unit + NM profiles)
selected_evidence.summary: systemd oneshot vlan-access-segmentation.service enabled and idempotent re-run verified on node1; NetworkManager connection profiles enp8s0-vlan10/enp8s0-vlan20 created with autoconnect on node2/node3

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 67c52137...; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id b55d8d35... confirms restart; VLAN10 IP and NM profile recovered, node1 ping to node2 succeeds post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 910dc564...; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 86d074bd... confirms restart; VLAN20 IP and NM profile recovered, node1 ping to node3 succeeds post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 (SONiC control-plane) restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state and cluster/service health
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 39fdb9ab...; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 7f0b6df0... confirms restart; vlan-access-segmentation.service auto-ran and restored bridge/VLAN/SVI state; docker containers (swss/bgp/syncd/database/gbsyncd) healthy post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart re-verification of connectivity and isolation on the fully recovered cluster
selected_evidence.summary: After all three restarts, node1 pings both node2 and node3 successfully in their respective VLANs, and the overlapping-subnet isolation test between node2/node3 still fails as expected, confirming the segmentation survived the full restart cycle

# Neutralize docker0 class-E leak per sonic-reference
ip addr del 240.127.1.1/24 dev docker0 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set docker0 down 2>/dev/null || true

# Clean any prior bridge from our testing
ip link del br0 2>/dev/null || true

# Create VLAN-aware bridge
ip link add name br0 type bridge vlan_filtering 1 stp_state 0
ip link set eth1 master br0
ip link set eth2 master br0

# Remove default VLAN 1 membership so ports are exclusively in their access VLAN
bridge vlan del vid 1 dev eth1 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan del vid 1 dev eth2 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan del vid 1 dev br0 self 2>/dev/null || true

# eth1 (node2 segment) -> access VLAN 10, untagged, PVID
bridge vlan add vid 10 dev eth1 pvid untagged
# eth2 (node3 segment) -> access VLAN 20, untagged, PVID
bridge vlan add vid 20 dev eth2 pvid untagged

# Bridge itself needs the VLANs registered so its SVIs can terminate them
bridge vlan add vid 10 dev br0 self
bridge vlan add vid 20 dev br0 self

ip link set eth1 up
ip link set eth2 up
ip link set br0 up

#!/bin/sh

bridge vlan add vid 20 dev eth2 pvid untagged 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan add vid 10 dev br0 self 2>/dev/null || true
bridge vlan add vid 20 dev br0 self 2>/dev/null || true

ip link show br0.10 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ip link add link br0 name br0.10 type vlan id 10
ip link show br0.20 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ip link add link br0 name br0.20 type vlan id 20

ip addr add 192.168.10.1/24 dev br0.10 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr add 192.168.20.1/24 dev br0.20 2>/dev/null || true

ip link set eth1 up
ip link set eth2 up
ip link set br0 up
ip link set br0.10 up
ip link set br0.20 up
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod +x /etc/systemd/system/vlan-access-segmentation.sh
cat > /etc/systemd/system/vlan-access-segmentation.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Recreate node1 VLAN access-port segmentation (eth1=VLAN10, eth2=VLAN20)
After=interfaces-config.service network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/etc/systemd/system/vlan-access-segmentation.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable vlan-access-segmentation.service
